fog-white.$description: Fog White — Dominant page canvas, section backgrounds, footer

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Nav background, button text, elevated surface

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary headline and body text — the only true dark for editorial content

carbon.$description: Carbon — Nav glyphs, link underlines, dark text on light surfaces

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body text, footer copy, muted helper text

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary body text and subdued link states

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav and link text at rest — sits between body text and pure black

iron.$description: Iron — Nav icons (fill) and button text — the dominant dark accent in chrome

silver.$description: Silver — Icon strokes, tertiary glyphs, muted UI controls

pale-mist.$description: Pale Mist — Hairline dividers, subtle borders between content blocks

ash-veil.$description: Ash Veil — Button backgrounds for secondary filled actions (dark mode variant)

iris-blue.$description: Iris Blue — Filled primary action buttons — the sole chromatic CTA, signals the only commitment the page asks of you

sapphire.$description: Sapphire — Outlined action buttons, body and link text — darker blue for outlined variants and inline links

sky-signal.$description: Sky Signal — Outlined action buttons on dark sections, secondary CTAs — lighter blue for ghost buttons against dark hero bands

cornflower.$description: Cornflower — Hover state for inline links, decorative link accent

ice-wash.$description: Ice Wash — Gradient section background wash — the pale blue tint behind iPad Air / MacBook Air hero bands

sf-pro-display.$description: Product headlines, large editorial display text. Used at 56px/600 for hero titles like 'MacBook Air' and 40px/600 for section subheads. The tighter 1.07 line height at 56px is signature — it lets the headline sit as a single visual block without breathing room between lines.

sf-pro-text.$description: Navigation, body copy, buttons, footer, subheads below display. The 17px/400/1.47 body setting appears 221 times — this is the workhorse. The 12px/400/1.33 setting handles everything in the footer and micro-copy. 44px/400/1.00 is the nav logo wordmark.
